material_findings_summary: No material incorrect claim, contradiction, or important in-scope omission identified against the complete authorized texts and inspected original publisher visual evidence.
scope: Original English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4 players including the required ordinary scoring two-player Rival, plus optional standard base-box CHOAM with 20 standard contracts; identify the 10 Rise of Ix compatibility contracts only for sorting. Exclude cross-game expansions, solo, optional Rival variants including Streamlined, six-player teams and later-product components. Apply relevant Jan 13 2025 general/Uprising FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: Original 2023 2–4-player game, ordinary scoring Rival and optional 20-contract CHOAM are distinguished from solo, variants, six-player and cross-game material. Counts and starting-deck composition agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Setup: shared decks and personal component destinations
checked_claims.detail: Conflict tiers, hidden shuffling/dealing, removed cards, objective selection and orientation, first player, 4P starting VP, Agents, troops, Spies, Councilor, Control markers, water and common bank agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Round start, Agent turns, Reveal turns and ordering
checked_claims.detail: Five phases, optional early Reveal, Plot timing, entry costs before destination/card effects, matching Agent access, single Agent placement, Faction advance once, freely ordered effects, Reveal strength timing and cleanup agree. Rival continuation follows its requirement to act while Agents remain.

checked_claims.claim_group: Combat and all player-count tie cases
checked_claims.detail: Eligible Combat Intrigues, consecutive passes, immediate strength changes, 0-strength exclusion, ordinary rank payouts, winner-card destination and ordered battle-icon check, troop/sandworm destinations agree. All tie cases in summary 187–199 and 336 agree.
Bonus spice only on Agent-free Maker spaces; end condition at Recall; human/Rival recall destinations and two-human first-player alternation agree.

Troops 2, sandworms 3, revealed swords 1; unit minimum; +20 marker; supply recruitment; new troops from all sources plus at most two old garrison troops; sandworms immediately deploy and never garrison; retreats return to garrison.

checked_claims.claim_group: Hooks, Shield Wall, critical locations and control
checked_claims.detail: Hooks are conditional prerequisites printed before summon effects, retained rather than spent. Three named protected locations, optional permanent Wall removal, control visit bonuses and defensive troop supply origin agree.
One or more worms double rewards, not control or battle icons; optional reward costs can be paid a second time; mandatory matching face-up pair, Objective eligibility and Endgame wild icon agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Acquisition, draw, discard, trash and in-play effects
checked_claims.detail: Persuasion pooling/splitting and expiry, row refill, acquired-card destination, reshuffling, optional trash exceptions, Reserve return, ordinary/Intrigue discard distinctions, acquire timing and Fremen Bond agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Influence, track bonuses, Alliances and VP
checked_claims.detail: 2-Influence VP reversal, retained/repeatable 4-Influence bonus, Alliance ownership and transfers including loss-triggered FAQ transfers agree; free-choice two-Influence icon stays in one Faction.

checked_claims.claim_group: Spies: placement, access, Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence
checked_claims.detail: Placement/ordinary recall optionality, no-supply recall, post restrictions, card requirement, another-player occupancy, connected-post access, immediate pre-effect draw, and distinct Spy use with at most one Gather Intelligence per placement agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Other standard icons, Intrigue timing, optional costs and Leaders
checked_claims.detail: Resource origins, once-per-turn arrows, Intrigue secrecy/discard/stealing, Recall Agent other-than-current rule, Swordmaster and listed Leader clarifications agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: CHOAM setup and Shaddam original printed abilities

source_references.detail: Independently viewed unannotated original physical Leader: both Sardaukar contracts set aside for exclusive acquisition; Signet prohibits all unit deployment this turn and offers 1 Solari + 1 troop OR 3 Solari for one any-Faction Influence.

checked_claims.detail: Optional Leader selection; 20 standard contracts vs 10 Rise of Ix contracts; reserved Sardaukar tokens not possessed initially; arithmetic of 18/16 bank contracts; separate Signet branches, cost and immediate turn-long restriction agree.

Public face-up acquisition/refill and empty-offer 2 Solari fallback agree, including non-Shaddam ineligibility for reserved tokens. Immediate/Harvest/Spice Must Flow completion, pre-held Agent-space contracts, mandatory simultaneous completion, freely ordered completion rewards and retained completed tokens agree.

source_references.detail: Independently viewed full unannotated publisher resource diagram; conversions are 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigues or 3 water for 1 VP.

checked_claims.detail: Initial water counts; exact Swordmaster total, Solari→spice→Intrigue→water spending order and leftovers, immediately usable third Agent, post-Swordmaster conversion thresholds, track bonus exclusion, Maker base/bonus spice and worms, own Hooks and conditional Wall removal agree.
